UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
                                          BEFORE THE
                            FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION

Cheyenne Power Hub, LLC                       )                       Docket No. EG27-___-000

                               NOTICE OF SELF-CERTIFICATION OF
                             EXEMPT WHOLESALE GENERATOR STATUS

        Pursuant to section 366.7(a) of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s
(“Commission”) rules,1 Cheyenne Power Hub, LLC (“CPH”) hereby submits this notice of self-
certification that it is an exempt wholesale generator (“EWG”) as defined in section 366.1 of the
Commission’s rules.2 In support of this notice, CPH states as follows:

I.         CORRESPONDENCE AND COMMUNICATIONS

       All communications and correspondence regarding this notice should be sent to the
following persons who are authorized to receive service:

II.        DESCRIPTION OF THE CPH

        CPH is a Delaware limited liability company that has been formed specifically to
develop, own, and operate an approximately 1,400 MW natural gas-fired generating facility and
associated interconnection assets (the “Facility”) that will be integrated with a co-located data
center in Laramie County, Wyoming. The Facility is estimated to begin generating electricity in
the fourth quarter of 2028. CPH is an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of Tallgrass Energy

1
    18 C.F.R. § 366.7(a).
2
    Id. § 366.1.
 Partners, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (“Tallgrass”) that owns, operates, acquires, and
develops midstream energy infrastructure in North America. Tallgrass operates over 10,000
miles of oil, natural gas, water, and carbon dioxide pipelines across fourteen states, including
certain jurisdictional natural gas pipeline and oil pipeline assets. However, Tallgrass is not an
electric utility company as defined in section 366.1 of the Commission’s regulations.

        The Facility will be comprised of natural gas-fired generators and associated facilities
and equipment necessary for the generation of power at wholesale. The Facility will also include
electric interconnection facilities necessary to effectuate CPH’s wholesale power sales from the
Facility. The Facility will be interconnected with the transmission system owned by Cheyenne
Light, Fuel and Power Company d/b/a Black Hills Energy.

III.      REPRESENTATIONS REGARDING EXEMPT WHOLESALE GENERATOR
          STATUS

       a. CPH will, directly, or indirectly through one or more affiliates as defined in section 366.1
          of the Commission’s regulations, be engaged exclusively in the business of owning and
          operating all or part of one or more eligible facilities and selling electric energy at
          wholesale, and activities incidental thereto.

       b. The Facility is an “eligible facility” because (i) it is used for the generation of electric
          energy exclusively for sale at wholesale; and (ii) it includes only those interconnecting
          transmission facilities that are necessary to effect a sale of electric energy at wholesale. 3

       c. All of the electric energy generated by the Facility will be sold directly within the United
          States of America exclusively at wholesale. CPH will not make any foreign sales of
          electric energy. CPH will not sell electricity at retail to any customer.

       d. There are no leasing arrangements involving the Facility and any public utility company
          or any affiliate or associate company of any public utility company.

       e. No portion of the Facility will be owned or operated by an “electric utility company” that
          is an “affiliate” or “associate company” of CPH, as defined in section 366.1 of the
          Commission’s regulations.

       f. No rate or charge for, or in connection with, the construction of the Facility, or for
          electric energy produced by the Facility was in effect under the laws of any state on
          October 24, 1992. Therefore, no determinations by a state commission are necessary for
          this Notice of Self-Certification to become effective.




3
  See Cheyenne Power Hub, LLC, 197 FERC ¶ 61,083 at P 13 (2026) (“We find that the CPH Interconnection
Facilities qualify as limited and discrete because they connect to a single point of interconnection on BHE’s
integrated transmission grid and there is no evidence in the record that the CPH Interconnection Facilities serve
broader network functions.”).

                                                          2
 IV.    STATE COMMISSION NOTIFICATION

        As required by section 366.7(a)(1) of the Commission’s regulations, a copy of this Notice
of Self-Certification has been filed with the State of Wyoming Public Service Commission, the
state regulatory authority of the state in which the Facility is located.

V.     CONCLUSION

      For the reasons set forth in this notice of self-certification, CPH satisfies the requirements
for EWG status.

Respectfully submitted,




L. Drew Cutright
Vice President – Regulatory Affairs
Tallgrass Energy, LP

Authorized Representative of Cheyenne Power Hub, LLC

Dated: November 4, 2026
